name: How Maps Work Quiz
description: Ten questions about scale, compass directions, contour lines and map keys.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Ten multiple-choice questions about how maps work, shown on Quick Quiz.
help.goal: Just for fun. Answer what you like; your score is shown only to you.
howToPlay: Read the question and choose an answer.
A short explanation follows each answer.
Press Next question to carry on.
At the end, Play again gives a fresh shuffle.
tips: No map needed. Everything is explained after each answer.
